findingDetails.title: Doctor compiled_routes repair hardcodes the authored destination path, duplicating layout.AUTHORED_PROGRAM_DIR
findingDetails.case: The authored router-program packet or the activation segment of CURRENT_LAYOUT is renamed. The guard still checks and prints the derived authored path, but the YAML repair keeps instructing the operator or agent to copy the runtime manifest over the old literal path under specs/sk-doc/z_archive/019-skill-routing-refactor/015-router-unification-program/013-live-activation/. The authored twin the guard reported stays missing (guard stays red), while the approved copy lands at a stale location that may hold an unrelated archived file.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Verified the literal destination exists today by listing the activation directory (manifest.json present); searched .skilled for a renderer or test linking the YAML literal to AUTHORED_PROGRAM_DIR and found none; the layout comment claims single naming for the hook, guard and sync only.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: YAML cannot require() the layout module, so a self-contained literal may be the only self-contained form; the operator sees the guard's correct path one step earlier and may never read the YAML path literally.
findingDetails.userImpact: On a layout move, an operator or agent following the approved repair writes the runtime manifest into the wrong directory (or fails), the guard remains red, and an archived file can be clobbered. No impact today.
findingDetails.recommendation: Do not restate destination endpoints in the YAML repair; reference the path the guard printed in the same run (its authored-missing or authored-drift fix line). If the literal stays, add a test that fails when it diverges from AUTHORED_PROGRAM_DIR.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A generator or test that renders the YAML repair from layout.AUTHORED_PROGRAM_DIR, or removal of the literal path from the repair string, withdraws this finding.

traceabilityChecks.notes: spec.md:3 maps the packet to R3/R7; the named-failure behavior is present at compiled-route-sync.cjs:1061 and compiled-route-guard.cjs:75. The YAML repair destination was observed to exist today; the finding is a latent single-source-of-truth breach against layout.cjs:53, not a current spec mismatch. goal.md grep battery carried from iteration 1.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Six in-scope files, 114 added lines including user-facing remediation text and guard control flow; security ledger required.

targetSelection.selectionReason: All six files named in the dispatch scope; compiled-route-layout.cjs and compiled-route-sync.cjs build() were cross-read to verify root derivation and trace-before-write ordering.
omittedHighRiskTargets: --finalize/--revert rollback-root argument handling in compiled-route-sync.cjs (unchanged by this diff; pre-existing surface, not this review mutation)

searchLedger.hypothesis: A printed fix string or the YAML repair is executed as a shell command and could carry untrusted metacharacters.

searchActions.result: Fix strings are template literals over REPO_ROOT-relative paths derived from the static HUBS list and layout constants; output goes through process.stdout.write only.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No exec/eval/shell sink; all path components originate from frozen constants.

searchLedger.hypothesis: path.join(authoredRoot, path.relative(runtimeRoot, runtimeManifest)) escapes authoredRoot when runtimeManifest is not under runtimeRoot.

searchActions.result: inspect passes only static HUBS ids; manifestPathIn derives the manifest beneath the root it is given; the roots parameters are a test seam.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No untrusted input reaches the parameters; production call sites derive the manifest under the root they pass.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A symlinked manifest passes the byte comparison while the authored source is not recoverable.

searchActions.result: existsSync/readFileSync follow symlinks; the build trace uses statSync().isFile() and copyFileSync, which also follow.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Gate and rebuild read through the same link, so byte identity is preserved; the gate is anti-accident, not anti-tamper.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An existsSync to readFileSync race flips the verdict or crashes.

searchActions.result: A race makes readFileSync throw; the guard exits non-zero and sync prints SYNC FAILED via its top-level catch.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Race outcome is fail-closed (non-zero exit or named failure); no bypass.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A missing or unreadable manifest still reports fresh.

searchActions.result: inspect returns on !manifestValid and !fresh before authoredDrift; authored-missing is now an explicit failure instead of the previous null.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No path from an absent manifest to ok:true; the change flips the previous fail-open to a named failure.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A repair instruction that restates the authored destination path points at a stale location after the packet or layout moves, so the approved copy writes over the wrong file.

searchActions.result: The repair restates both copy endpoints as literals.
The guard already prints the derived authored path per hub.
layout.cjs owns the name; the YAML restates it; no generator or test reconciles the two.

searchLedger.rationale: Latent destructive-target drift in an approved repair instruction; single-source-of-truth breach.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The exemptions file can excuse drift/missing findings or a forged expiry.

searchActions.result: Only inputs-do-not-compile is excusable; expiry must parse and be in the future.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: authored-missing and authored-drift never match EXCUSABLE; an actor who can edit exemptions can edit the gate itself.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An authored twin that is a directory, unreadable, or removed mid-check throws out of authoredDrift, giving a raw stack in the guard and breaking --warn-only exit 0.

searchActions.result: readFileSync can throw EISDIR/EACCES/ENOENT; main has no try/catch and --warn-only still exits through main.

searchLedger.deferredReason: Fail-closed (non-zero), so not a security bypass; robustness and the --warn-only contract belong to the maintainability dimension.
